complete-game.title: Welcome to Vaeleth
complete-game.description: Learn to become a divine ruler of a fantasy realm

steps.title: Welcome to Vaeleth
steps.content: Welcome, aspiring deity! In Vaeleth, you'll create a god, design a fantasy race, and shape a persistent world through strategic actions. Let's begin your divine journey.

steps.title: Create Your Deity
steps.content: Every great civilization needs a divine ruler. You'll choose your name, domain, and divine powers. Your domain influences your strengths in different actions.

steps.title: Choose Your Divine Name
steps.content: Enter a name that will strike awe into the hearts of mortals. This will be how other players know you.

steps.title: Select Your Domain
steps.content: Your domain grants special bonuses to certain actions. Fire excels at destruction, Nature at growth, Knowledge at research, etc.

steps.title: Ascend to Godhood
steps.content: Click 'Ascend' to confirm your divine identity and begin your reign over Vaeleth.

steps.title: Design Your People
steps.content: Every deity needs followers! Now you'll create a fantasy race with unique traits. You have 100 points to spend on characteristics.

steps.title: Name Your Race
steps.content: Give your people a name that reflects their nature and your divine influence.

steps.title: Add Characteristics
steps.content: Choose traits for your race. Positive traits cost points, negative traits give you points to spend elsewhere. Try adding 'Swift' for movement bonuses.

steps.title: Balance Your Race
steps.content: Notice how your remaining points change. You can add negative traits to get more points for powerful positive ones. Create a race that fits your strategy!

steps.title: Bring Your Race to Life
steps.content: When satisfied with your race design, click 'Create' to populate your realm with these beings.

steps.title: Rule Your Realm
steps.content: Welcome to the heart of Vaeleth! Here you'll spend resources on actions that shape the world. Every decision matters.

steps.title: Your Divine Resources
steps.content: You have 5 types of points: Action (general activities), Wealth (construction), Magic (research), Influence (diplomacy), and Command (military).

steps.title: Take Your First Action
steps.content: Try selecting 'Exploration' to discover new territories and resources. Each action has costs and potential outcomes.

steps.title: Confirm Your Action
steps.content: Click 'Confirm Action' to add Exploration to your weekly plans. You can add multiple actions if you have enough resources.

steps.title: Explore the World Map
steps.content: The World Map shows territories you can discover, claim, and build upon. Let's take a look at your domain.

steps.title: Interact with Territories
steps.content: Click on territories to see details and take actions. You can scout unknown lands, claim territories, or build structures in ones you control.

steps.title: Divine Communication
steps.content: The Discussion Board lets you communicate with other deities. Form alliances, declare wars, or simply engage in divine discourse.

steps.title: Chronicle of Events
steps.content: The Timeline records all major events in Vaeleth. Your actions and those of other players create a persistent history.

steps.title: Your Divine Reign Begins
steps.content: Congratulations! You now know the basics of Vaeleth. Explore, expand, and engage with other players to shape this fantasy world. Your legend awaits!

deity-creation.title: Create Your Deity
deity-creation.description: Learn to design your divine identity

steps.title: Divine Identity
steps.content: Choose your player name (your real identity) and deity name (your divine persona). Other players will see both.

steps.title: Domain Powers
steps.content: Your domain affects your success rates. Fire excels at destruction and forging, Water at exploration and healing, Knowledge at research, etc.

race-creation.title: Design Your Fantasy Race
race-creation.description: Create unique beings to serve your will

steps.title: 100-Point System
steps.content: You have 100 points to spend. Positive traits cost points, negative traits give points back. Plan carefully!

steps.title: Strategic Trait Selection
steps.content: Consider your deity's domain. A Fire deity might want heat-resistant races, while Nature deities benefit from forest-dwelling traits.
